name: Mist
source: Apathetic, enigmatic, haunting. Very little is known about Mist. Witha  pair of eyes as though they could see through others and eerie smile, she can be playful and at times downright sadistic. is she a friend or a foe? No one really knows. She comes and disappears like a mist.
